categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches descriptor management logic in src/script/descriptor.cpp, which governs descriptor validation and parsing used by descriptor wallets.
categories.rationale: Fixes a validation bug where Tapscript Miniscript descriptors with keys sharing an x-coordinate pass sanity checks, breaking BIP-379 non-malleability guarantees. The PR description notes that 'BIP-379 malleability analysis relies on the invariant that no public key is repeated' and that failing to detect identical x-only keys allows 'a third party [to] malleate transactions by flipping the branch selector without possessing the private key'.
